lessons.title: 2. Variables & Arithmetic
lessons.concept:
### Data Types in Java
Java is strictly typed:
- `int score = 500;`
- `double price = 19.99;`
- `String name = "Alex";`

```java
int a = 20;
int b = 30;
System.out.println(a + b); // 50
```
lessons.task: Given `int attack = 15;` and `int bonus = 10;`, compute `int totalAttack = attack + bonus;` and print `totalAttack`.
